notes: Scope: the archdiocesan parish finder (archphila.org/parish/, 40 entries per page, 9 pages) was read on pages 1 and 2 only, because of the fetch budget. Pages 3 to 9 are unread, so many city parishes are missing; a later wave could start at archphila.org/parish/page/3/. The archdiocese's own address now redirects to catholicchurchofphila.org, and the old parish-finder path returned 404. Page 1 and 2 city parishes with closing years in their names (for example St. Agatha 1865 to 1976, All Saints 1860 to 2013, St. Benedict 1922 to 2013, St. Casimir 1893 to 2011, St. Donato 1910 to 2013, St. Edmond 1912 to 2014) are not recorded, since the listing marks them as closed. Ten records rest on the archdiocesan page alone, because the parish sites were blocked or unreachable. Divine Mercy's website address on the archdiocesan page now shows an unrelated gambling page. Searches: 3 used (St. Vincent de Paul, young adult groups, food pantries). The food pantry search found only non-parish or unverified options, so no food pantry was recorded beyond the St. Athanasius and St. Gabriel entries. A search result mentioned a Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday food cupboard at St. Gabriel and a Monday distribution at St. Thomas Aquinas on Morris Street, but neither source could be reached, so neither is recorded. The Well, a one time young adult conference on November 7, 2026 at the Sheraton and Cathedral, is an event rather than a group and is not recorded. A Czestochowa page returned 404 and the parish finder's old path returned 404. Status counts: active 5, probably active 6, dormant 1, unknown 10. Verdicts: publish 22.
